title: Update Pi agent and show server version
Review project guidance and relevant worklog history
Inspect dependency, server, and UI version-display implementation points

content: Started by reading required development skills, checking repository status, listing existing worklogs, and creating the feature branch chore/update-pi-agent-version-display.

observation: Development work should use simple, test-driven changes where practical, avoid unnecessary fallback/defensive complexity, and pause for human clarification on unresolved blockers.

Use structured worklog tools as source of truth: track research tasks, record meaningful observations, add implementation tasks before changing code, and verify all tasks are finished/canceled before reporting completion.
Code changes should keep functions small, intention-revealing, focused on one responsibility, and covered by tests where feasible.
Repository was clean on main before work; created branch chore/update-pi-agent-version-display.

Project is a pnpm workspace with host daemon embedding @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent via SDK, mobile Expo app connecting to host, and shared protocol/types. Host status endpoint is GET /api/host/status; validation commands are pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build, pnpm test:coverage.

Previous Pi dependency upgrade used `pnpm --filter @pi-mobile/host add @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@<latest>`, then validated with frozen install, root typecheck/test/build, and whitespace check. Last known latest was 0.78.0, with Node >=22.19.0.
Earlier upgrade changed only apps/host/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml and confirmed host SDK integration via typecheck and host tests; this remains the expected update path.

content: Reviewed required skills, README project overview/API notes, and the two prior Pi dependency upgrade worklogs. The established dependency-update path is host-workspace pnpm add plus typecheck/test/build validation.
Inspecting package manifests, current latest package metadata, host status API, shared protocol types, mobile connection/status screens, and tests before planning implementation.

observation: npm latest is @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.78.1 and requires Node >=22.19.0; local Node v25.9.0 and pnpm 10.33.2 satisfy this.
The Pi SDK exports a VERSION constant from its public package entry point, so the host can report the actual embedded Pi coding agent version without reading package.json subpaths.
HostStatus currently includes name, version, platform, cwd, pid, and sdkMode. The existing version is the mobile host daemon version, not the embedded Pi coding agent version.
HostController.getStatus hard-codes host version 0.1.0 and is the source for GET /api/host/status and websocket host_status events.
The mobile app displays state.client.connectionMessage on Home and Host screens, and the shared reducer currently formats that message as '<host name> on <platform>' with no Pi version shown.

Existing host/mobile/shared tests cover status endpoint behavior, host client parsing, app connected state, and shared host_status reduction; these are the right places to add expectations for the Pi coding agent version.

content: Found current Pi dependency 0.78.0, npm latest 0.78.1, and the status/display implementation points. The public Pi SDK exports VERSION, so HostController can expose piCodingAgentVersion on HostStatus and the mobile app can show it via the existing host_status flow.
Planning the implementation now that version source, API shape, UI display point, tests, and dependency update command are known.

observation: No blockers identified. Plan is to upgrade @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to npm latest 0.78.1, add tests for HostStatus piCodingAgentVersion and mobile connection messaging, implement status propagation from the SDK VERSION export through shared protocol/reducer/mobile display, validate with diagnostics/typecheck/tests/build, then commit and open a PR if GitHub CLI is available.

content: Implementation plan drafted with no open blockers. The change can proceed without further human clarification.
